canonical_claim: For a triangular array of independent real random variables, if some positive delta moment exists and the sum of centered absolute (2+delta)-moments divided by the row standard-deviation scale to the power 2+delta tends to zero, then the centered row sums normalized by that scale converge in distribution to the standard normal law.
